+ * Grants a table marked "adminOnly" to a backend user who is no
+ * administrator, e.g. be_users to an editor who manages other editors.
+ * Grants of backend groups never cover such a table, and a voter of an
+ * extension cannot grant it, as the TableVoter denies it. This is the only
+ * way to grant it: the policy decision point asks every implementation,
+ * and a single grant suffices. Voters of extensions still restrict the
+ * decision. The DataHandler does not ask voters yet and keeps writing
+ * admin only tables for administrators only.
+ * Granting a table grants every field of it that is no exclude field.
+ * be_users marks no field as exclude field: granting be_users grants
+ * changing "admin", "password" and "usergroup" as well. Restrict the fields
+ * the grant is not meant for with a voter of the extension.
+ * @internal Experimental, not yet public API: it may still change until
+ * the checks of BackendUserAuthentication are migrated to the voters.
+     * Whether the backend principal, who is no administrator, may read or
+     * change records of the admin only table
+     * @param string $table the main table, never a sub-schema
+    public function isGranted(Principal $principal, string $scope, string $table): bool;

+ * The policy decision point (PDP) answers one question for the Core voters:
+ * does a grant of the principal cover this scope on this resource? It knows
+ * where grants are stored, the voters know when a grant is needed at all,
+ * for example for a module with the access "admin".
+ * A PDP only knows the resource types and scopes it has grants for, see
+ * supports(). For those, decide() answers allow or deny, never abstain.
+ * Voters ask supports() first and abstain otherwise, so that a voter of an
+ * extension decides on resource types of its own.
+ * @internal not part of TYPO3 Core API yet, still experimental as part of the
+     * Whether grants for the scope on the type of the resource exist at all.
+     * Whether a grant of the principal covers the scope on the resource,
+     * false for a scope or resource type the PDP does not support.
+    public function decide(Principal $principal, string $scope, ResourceIdentifier $resource): bool;

+ * Names a resource by a type and an identifier within that type, e.g. the
+ * page type "254" or the custom option "tx_news:publish".
+ * It is the subject of isGranted() for resources that have no object of
+ * Resources with an object are checked on that object instead, e.g. a
+ * table on its TcaSchema or a module on its ModuleInterface. A language is
+ * checked on its SiteLanguage, or on its id where no site is at hand.
+ * The constants name the types TYPO3 Core grants through backend groups.
+ * The ResourceVoter decides on those without an object of their own, the
+ * LanguageVoter on languages; the types table, field, module and widget
+ * are only used by the voters of TYPO3 Core towards the policy decision
+ * point. An extension may use a type
+ * of its own, prefixed with its extension key, and decides on it with a
+ * voter of its own: isGranted(Scope::ACCESS, new ResourceIdentifier('tx_shop_discount', 'staff')).
+ * The ResourceVoter abstains on such types.
